newsitem.title: USA: Digi Int'l releases software upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Digi Int'l releases software upgrade.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Monday it is shipping a new software release for its Retoura product line it claims provides users with the most complete small router solution in the industry.
The company said the new version of the software offers Frame Relay support, systems to identify network users and a separate routing option for network managers.
Digi said the new release has a list price ranging from $1,495 to $1,750 depending on the configuration.
Digi provides data communications hardware and software.
Its shares closed up 1/16 Monday at 8-3/4.
